sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos vs. Chiefs practice participation report: Wednesday
sources.description: The Denver Broncos come into the week with a few questions on the injury front. Defensive lineman Zach Allen came up lame after a play with a hamstring issue and wide receiver Jaylen Waddle reinjured his chest. Both were at practice on Wednesday, but did not participate. It’s probably a good sign they were there […]
